title: Vampire Vape Rhubarb and Custard E-Liquid 10ml
description: Experience a dessert lover's delight with Vampire Vape Rhubarb and Custard E-Liquid 10ml. This e-juice delivers a nostalgic and irresistibly moreish blend of creamy custard. That's perfectly complemented by the tangy notes of rhubarb. With each inhale and exhale of this Rhubarb and Custard Vampire Vape E-Liquid, you'll be treated to the fresh and tart flavour of rhubarb. That's beautifully balanced with dollops of warm, freshly whipped custard. The result is a rich and indulgent taste that will leave you with a taste and aroma of pure bliss. Making this combination of creamy custard and tangy rhubarb a delightful choice for vapers seeking a dessert-based E Liquid that stands out from the crowd. Each bottle of this Vampire Vape Rhubarb and Custard offers a balanced blend of PG (Propylene Glycol) and VG (Vegetable Glycerin). Ensuring that it can deliver maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please note: that the specific PG/VG ratio varies depending on the nicotine strength in each bottle of nicotine E Liquid. For the 3 mg nicotine strength, the E-Liquid has a 50VG/50PG ratio. Whilst the 3 mg, 6 mg, 12 mg, and 18 mg nicotine strengths contain a 40VG/60PG ratio. Rhubarb and Custard by Vampire Vape is a versatile blend that can be used with most vape devices to deliver a satisfying vaping experience. Making it ideal for use with low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits, and pod kits. If you love this 10ml bottle of Rhubarb and Custard Vampire Vape vape juice, why not explore their other equally delicious popular flavours. Their iconic E-Liquid collection offers a broad range to choose from to suit a variety of vaping needs. So whether you're looking for your next seriously smooth nicotine salt Vampire Vape Nic Salt for a perfectly smooth throat hit. Or inspired to make your own vape juice blends with their Vampire Vape Flavour Concentrates. You're sure to find a vape juice flavour and type that suits your vaping needs.
